contract: MSVC Win32, little endian, 8-bit byte and 32-bit pointer/int/unsigned int. This is a new ordinary typed API.
Count zero admits any pointer including null, returns null before Source target conversion and before all payload reads. The strict object also branches before buffer/target argument-home loads.

Positive count requires stable determinate readable requested bytes in one actual live allocation; endpoint may be inside or one past it, admitting interior subranges/prefixes. Actual 32-bit extent and advances do not wrap.

All int values select low eight bits. No NUL/padding/initial alignment/typed Uint32 allocation, signed-count cap, pointer subtraction, before-base transient, runtime validation or new ownership condition.
Volatile BYTE peel to actual four-byte alignment. Complete aligned in-range DWORDs only. A DWORD can include later requested bytes beyond the first match.

For x=word^repeated_target retain unsigned32 ((x+0x7efefeff)^~x)&0x81010100. Zero candidate has no reread. Nonzero candidate rereads exactly the same DWORD once, then tests register lanes low-to-high, including rejecting the high-XOR-byte-0x80 false-positive class.

Finish with ordered zero-to-three BYTE tail; return genuine borrowed first-match pointer/null, with no final payload reread or payload writes. Stable read-only aliases admitted; result borrows owner lifetime.
No SDK search/memcpy/fallback/provider/global/Original caller binding. Mutation, concurrency, faults, invalid positive-count storage and volatile/MMIO protocols are outside this ordinary domain.

static_math_and_bounds.filter: Accepted readiness static carry proof: no zero XOR lane is missed; the no-match high-XOR-byte-0x80 candidate is rejected by the same-word register-lane checks. No enumerator or body execution.
static_math_and_bounds.bounds: BYTE accesses require positive residual; DWORD accesses require residual >=4 and actual alignment. Count and genuine pointer advances stay within requested extent/endpoint. No signed residual or underflow-based access.
static_math_and_bounds.uncertainty: Original instruction/fault/register/flag/home identity is not asserted; behavior is confined to stable ordinary storage.
